title: 24th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/24/2024).

Question time: Velidhoo MP Mohamed Abbas asks Minister of Health Dr Abdulla Khaleel what has been done so far to establish a health centre on N. Fohdhoo, a small island he says past governments left without basic services, and how long before practical work begins.

Question time: Velidhoo MP Mohamed Abbas asks Minister of Health Dr Abdulla Khaleel what has been done on the planned additional building to expand N. Lhohi Health Centre and how long before construction begins.
Preliminary debate on the Insurance Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Mahibadhoo MP Ahmed Thoriq.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting put two health-centre questions (Fohdhoo and Lhohi) to the health minister and opened debate on the government's Insurance Bill.
